stages.ix_title: Complete the sentence with the correct closed vowel exception word

what_to_do.en: Tap the closed vowel exception word that fits.
what_to_do.ko: 알맞은 닫힌 모음 예외 낱말을 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Use four different lowercase whole words. Mark the missing word with a single hyphen, and keep the stem at ten words or fewer. The correct word is one closed vowel exception from the old, olt, ost, ind, or ild patterns: old, cold, gold, hold, fold, told, sold, bold, bolt, colt, most, post, host, find, kind, mind, blind, child, wild, or mild. Exactly one choice may finish the sentence. Other stem words must be in the roots word list or allowed_extra_words. Use <NAME> instead of a real name. Do not add pictures or audio.

gold_items.stem: The little - has a pet dog.
Dad dug up - in the sand.
Please - my hand on the bus.
She was - to her friend at school.
I like the red fruit - of all.
<NAME> - us a funny story before bedtime today.

roots: The correct choice is one closed vowel exception from the old, olt, ost, ind, or ild pattern.
Give four lowercase whole words, and make sure only one choice completes the sentence.
Tier 1 distractors are exception words from a different pattern that clearly do not fit.
Tier 2 distractors are other exception words that almost fit the meaning but do not.
Tier 3 distractors are near spellings, such as most beside post, or hold beside fold and told.
Cost and lost may appear beside an ost word as look-alikes, but they are never the correct answer.
Do not use wind as a correct answer. Do not use misspellings, brands, or real names.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of about six words on a familiar kid topic. The answer is an easy word such as cold, find, or child, and the other choices clearly do not fit.
tier_rules.2: Grade 2 stems of about seven or eight words. The answer is a closed vowel exception such as gold, hold, or kind, with other exception words as close distractors.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss choices such as most, post, cost, and lost, or told, hold, fold, and old. Stems can run to nine words and still have only one word that fits.
